subject.title: fix: keep inbound metadata in runtime context

question: Should the canonical fix be this focused before-user runtime-context handoff, or the newer tail-carrier/cache-stability PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272?
rationale: Both branches route current inbound metadata out of user prompt text, but they choose different carrier placement and scope; automation cannot decide the permanent prompt/cache contract for agent/provider behavior.

options.title: Use the tail-carrier PR as canonical
options.body: Prefer the newer branch if maintainers want this fix to also solve active-versus-historical byte stability and provider cache-anchor placement.

options.title: Land the focused branch first
options.body: Merge this smaller handoff after refresh if maintainers want the model-comprehension fix separated from provider cache work.

options.title: Fold tail placement into this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the credit/source branch but port the tail-carrier and cache-anchor behavior here before landing.

recommendation.title: Use the tail-carrier PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Prefer the newer branch if maintainers want this fix to also solve active-versus-historical byte stability and provider cache-anchor placement.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman merged the prior cache-stability boundary work and is the strongest routing signal for the carrier placement choice.
